D: Superman tries to do good in a world that doesn't trust him, while Lex Luthor plots to bring him down.
P: Serve the snacks when Krypto comes bounding in.
S: Krypto's pork and sage sausage rolls

Pork mince, onion and sage wrapped in buttery puff pastry, baked golden and flaky, cut into bites with tomato relish for dipping. Mix 500g pork mince with 1 grated onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage, 40g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, salt and pepper. Halve 2 puff pastry sheets, lay a line of filling along each strip and roll up, seam down. Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut into 4cm bites. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve with tomato relish.
Mini bagels with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers and dill
Mini bagels split and toasted, spread with cream cheese and topped with smoked salmon, capers and red onion.
Fortress crystal prawn rice paper rolls
Prawns and vermicelli wrapped in rice paper

See-through rice paper rolls packed with prawns, vermicelli, crisp cucumber, mint and coriander, served chilled with a sweet chilli lime dip. Soak 100g rice vermicelli in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and cool. Halve 300g cooked peeled prawns lengthways. Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for 10 seconds and lay flat. Add prawns, noodles, cucumber sticks, mint and coriander, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Repeat to make 12. Mix 4 tbsp sweet chilli sauce with the juice of 1 lime and 1 tsp fish sauce for dipping.
M: Beef chuck braised with carrots, onion and thyme, potatoes added

Beef chuck pot roast braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrots and potatoes, gravy from the pot. Brown a 1.5kg piece of beef chuck all over. Add a sliced onion, 3 carrots, 500ml beef stock and thyme. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours, adding 800g potatoes for the last hour. Thicken the juices into gravy and serve family style.

Spiced chicken thighs chargrilled and sliced into warm flatbread with tomato, lettuce, pickles and a punchy garlic sauce. Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 3 tbsp yoghurt, the juice of 1 lemon, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika and 1/2 tsp cinnamon for 1 hour. Grill over high heat for 5 minutes a side and slice. Mix 150g Greek yoghurt with 2 crushed garlic cloves, lemon juice and salt. Warm 4 flatbreads, spread with garlic sauce and fill with chicken, lettuce, tomato and pickles. Roll tightly in paper.
W: Cream biscuits layered with sugared strawberries
Buttery shortcake scones baked at 220C for 15 minutes, split and filled with whipped cream and strawberries macerated in sugar for half an hour.
K: Vanilla ice cream, honey and malted milk powder, blended thick

Cold farm milk blended thick with vanilla ice cream, honey and malt powder, topped with whipped cream and a drizzle of honey. Put 800ml cold milk, 6 scoops of vanilla ice cream, 3 tbsp honey, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tsp vanilla in a blender and blend for 30 seconds until thick and frothy. Pour into 4 chilled tall glasses. Top each with a spoon of whipped cream and a thin drizzle of honey, and serve with straws.
